item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00428","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C07","C02","C10"],"selected_candidate_label":"C07","confidence":0.78,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C07 plausibly supplied the concrete template for the child's appeals machinery. Both establish boards to review adverse individual determinations and prescribe a deliberately representative composition including labor and industry/management members. The child adapts that structure to Coast Guard security-document decisions by using one Coast Guard officer, one management member, and one labor member. C02 also contains a tripartite public-labor-business board, but its stabilization-policy role is less closely aligned with the child's adjudicative appeal board. C10 shares emergency possession, protection, delegation, and interagency-assistance concepts, but those parallels are less distinctive and arise in materially different operative machinery.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Persons who are refused employment or who are refused the issuance of documents or who are required to surrender such documents... shall have the right of appeal, and the Commandant shall appoint Boards for acting on such appeals.","parent_excerpt":"The appeal board shall have jurisdiction to review and to affirm or change any decision appealed to it from any local board in its area...","explanation":"Both use an appointed administrative board to review adverse determinations affecting individuals."},{"child_excerpt":"Each such Board shall, so far as practicable, be composed of one Coast Guard officer, one member drawn from management, and one member drawn from labor.","parent_excerpt":"The appeal board should be a composite board, representative of the activities of its area, and as such should include one member from labor, one member from industry, one physician, one lawyer, and, where applicable, one member from agriculture.","explanation":"The child closely adapts C07's representative appeal-board composition, retaining paired labor and industry/management representation while substituting a Coast Guard officer for the additional specialist members."}]}
